लुभ् {vI.v} {c6c} P. To bewilder,
confound, perplex. {vII.v} {c4c} P. (लुभ्यति,
लुब्ध)
1 To covet, long for, desire
eagerly (with dat. or loc.); तथापि
रामो लुलुभे मृगाय.
--2 To allure, entice.
--3 To be bewildered or perplexed,
go astray. --Caus. (लोभयति-ते)
1
To make greedy, cause to long
for, produce or excite desire for;
पुप्लुवे बहु लाभयन्

.
--2 To
excite lust.
--3 To entire, seduce,
allure, attract: लोभ्यमाननयनः
श्लथांशुकैर्मेखलागुणपदौर्नितंबिभिः
